dimensions.assessment: Affects Small Business Administration leadership, administrative personnel, and members of specific congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: the Administrator shall submit to the Committee on Small Business of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship of the Senate a report

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative reporting and briefing requirements without altering agency operational authorities or benefits.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 30 days after the date on which the Administrator submits each report... the Administrator shall provide... a briefing on such report

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state or imply any specific funding, spending, or revenue effects.
Amends Section 10(c) of the Small Business Act to mandate specific annual reporting and congressional briefings on artificial intelligence and machine learning use.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10(c) of the Small Business Act is amended to read as follows...

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing, permanent annual reporting requirement for the agency.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this subsection, and annually thereafter

missing_information: Any cost estimates or resource allocations required for preparing the mandated reports and briefings.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Small Business Administration to submit annual reports and briefings to congressional committees regarding its use of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
